title: Bug: No Date/Time picker for Libre sensor when "Not today" is selected and start time is reported 24 hours in the past
body:
Hello,

I have noticed that when I start new Libre sensor and select "Not today" there is no Date/Time picker to select exact date and time when sensor was started. Also the sensor start time in logs is reported 1 day in the past.
E.g. I have changed sensor today 2019-08-12 but in xDrip+ logs there is:

NEW SENSOR
14:24 Sensor started at 2019-08-11 14:24:35

This also affects Nightscout upload as it is also uploaded incorrectly - see entry from MongoDB:

{ "_id" : ObjectId("0e84a2f5dc2d405ebb7a3cbc"),
"timestamp" : 1565529875527,
"eventType" : "Sensor Start",
"enteredBy" : "xdrip",
"uuid" : "",
"created_at" : "2019-08-11T13:24:35.000Z",  <-----
"sysTime" : "2019-08-11T15:24:35.527+0200",  <-----
"utcOffset" : 0 }

Hence it affects SAGE plugin as sensor age is reported incorrectly.

![nightscout_sage](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/51976401/62871339-9ef2f500-bd1b-11e9-8d85-441d1ee954f7.png)

I have briefly checked xDrip+ source code and found possible source of the issue. In StartNewSensor.java there is:

if (DexCollectionType.hasLibre()) {
                    ucalendar.add(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH, -1);
                    realStartSensor();
                } else { 

Not sure why it is there and date is shifted 1 day back.
I think there should be code to display Date/Time picker as user can select exact date and time when sensor was started.

Also I'm a little bit confused why sensor start time is adjusted by -1 hour when option "Yes, today" is selected and Time has been picked up in dialog:

ucalendar.add(Calendar.HOUR_OF_DAY, -1); // hack for warmup time 

It is questionable whether is it OK because the dialog says "What time was it inserted?" So I would expect that I should enter time when sensor was inserted and started by Libre reader/LibreLink app. If so the code above actually makes sensor start time 1 hour earlier than it was actually.
In my opinion this is confusing and it should be removed.
Thanks.
